description: This file provides functions for parsing custom color markup in text and updating Feishu document text blocks with styled text segments. It includes color parsing logic, style application, and API interaction with the Lark SDK.

methods.name: parseColorMarkup
methods.description: Parses a string with custom color markup into styled text segments.

methods.name: updateColorText
methods.description: Updates a Feishu document text block with styled text segments based on markup.
